50436-protestantism-and-catholicity-comp.creator: Unknown
50436-protestantism-and-catholicity-comp.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This disposition of men's minds naturally drew their attention to the religious revolution of the sixteenth century; it was natural that they should ask what this revolution had done to promote the interests of humanity. Unhappily, great mistakes have been made in this inquiry.

arxiv-1807-10273.title: The top-quark window on compositeness at future lepton colliders Preprint: DESY 18-114
arxiv-1807-10273.creator: Gauthier Durieux, Oleksii Matsedonskyi
arxiv-1807-10273.description: Abstract In composite Higgs (CH) models, large mixings between the top quark and the new strongly interacting sector are required to generate its sizeable Yukawa coupling. Precise measurements involving top as well as left-handed bottom quarks therefore offer an interesting opportunity to probe such new physics scenarios.

arxiv-2108-12030.title: The Mixed-Observable Constrained Linear Quadratic Regulator Problem: the Exact Solution and Practical Algorithms
arxiv-2108-12030.creator: Ugo Rosolia, Yuxiao Chen, Shreyansh Daftry, Masahiro Ono, Yisong Yue, Aaron D. Ames
arxiv-2108-12030.description: Abstract This paper studies the problem of steering a linear system subject to state and input constraints towards a goal location that may be inferred only through noisy partial observations. We assume mixed-observable settings, where the system’s state is fully observable and the environment’s state defining the goal location is only partially observed.

arxiv-2112-10590.title: The Scattering of Dirac and Majorana Fermions in Spherically Symmetric Gravitational Field and Torsion Field
arxiv-2112-10590.creator: Junhui Lai, Xun Xue
arxiv-2112-10590.description: Abstract The possibility to distinguish Dirac from Majorana fermion by gravitational interaction and torsion coupling is discussed. The scattering of both Dirac and Majorana particles are the same in the spherically symmetric gravitational field up to the first order perturbation of the fermion-gravity interaction.

arxiv-2301-09125.title: Selecting a suitable Parallel Label-propagation based algorithm for Disjoint Community Detection
arxiv-2301-09125.creator: Subhajit Sahu
arxiv-2301-09125.description: Abstract Community detection is an essential task in network analysis as it helps identify groups and patterns within a network. High-speed community detection algorithms are necessary to analyze large-scale networks in a reasonable amount of time. Researchers have made significant contributions in the development of high-speed community detection algorithms, particularly in the area of label-propagation based disjoint community detection.

arxiv-2301-11520.title: SNeRL: Semantic-aware Neural Radiance Fields for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2301-11520.creator: Dongseok Shim, Seungjae Lee, H. Jin Kim
arxiv-2301-11520.description: Abstract As previous representations for reinforcement learning cannot effectively incorporate a human-intuitive understanding of the 3D environment, they usually suffer from sub-optimal performances. In this paper, we present Semantic-aware Neural Radiance Fields for Reinforcement Learning (SNeRL), which jointly optimizes semantic-aware neural radiance fields (NeRF) with a convolutional encoder to learn 3D-aware neural implicit representation from multi-view images.

arxiv-2302-11211.title: Distributionally Robust Recourse Action
arxiv-2302-11211.creator: Duy Nguyen 1, Ngoc Bui 1, Viet Anh Nguyen 2
arxiv-2302-11211.description: Abstract A recourse action aims to explain a particular algorithmic decision by showing one specific way in which the instance could be modified to receive an alternate outcome. Existing recourse generation methods often assume that the machine learning model does not change over time.

arxiv-2310-14389.title: Evaluating Subjective Cognitive Appraisals of Emotions from Large Language Models
arxiv-2310-14389.creator: Hongli Zhan, Desmond C. Ong, Junyi Jessy Li
arxiv-2310-14389.description: Abstract The emotions we experience involve complex processes; besides physiological aspects, research in psychology has studied cognitive appraisals where people assess their situations subjectively, according to their own values Scherer 2005 . Thus, the same situation can often result in different emotional experiences.

arxiv-2403-12010.title: VideoMV: Consistent Multi-View Generation Based on Large Video Generative Model
arxiv-2403-12010.creator: Qi Zuo, Xiaodong Gu, Lingteng Qiu, Yuan Dong, Zhengyi Zhao, Weihao Yuan, Rui Peng, Siyu Zhu, Zilong Dong, Liefeng Bo, Qixing Huang
arxiv-2403-12010.description: Abstract Generating multi-view images based on text or single-image prompts is a critical capability for the creation of 3D content. Two fundamental questions on this topic are what data we use for training and how to ensure multi-view consistency. This paper introduces a novel framework that makes fundamental contributions to both questions.

arxiv-2407-10276.title: The Error Analysis of the Secret Key Generation Algorithm Using Analog Function Computation PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-8481-9/24/$31.00 ©2024 IEEE
arxiv-2407-10276.creator: Ertugrul Alper 1 , Eray Guven 2 , Gunes Karabulut Kurt 2 , Enver Ozdemir 1
arxiv-2407-10276.description: Abstract This study introduces a decentralized approach to secure wireless communication using a cryptographic secret key generation algorithm among distributed nodes. The system model employs Gaussian prime numbers, ensuring the collaborative generation of a secret key. Pre-processing and post-processing functions enable to generate a secret key across the network.

arxiv-2501-14819.title: A Comprehensive Mathematical and System-Level Analysis of Autonomous Vehicle Timelines Integrating Complexity Theory, Reliability Growth, and ODD Modeling
arxiv-2501-14819.creator: Paul Perrone – Founder/CEO, Perrone Robotics, Inc.
arxiv-2501-14819.description: Abstract Fully autonomous vehicles (AVs) continue to spark immense global interest, yet predictions on when they will operate safely and broadly remain heavily debated. This paper synthesizes two distinct research traditions— computational complexity and algorithmic constraints versus reliability growth modeling and real-world testing —to form an integrated, quantitative timeline for future AV deployment.

arxiv-2601-20446.title: Probing the Diversity of Type Ia Supernova Remnants in 3-D Hydrodynamic Simulations with X-ray Spectral Synthesis
arxiv-2601-20446.creator: Yusei Fujimaru, Shiu-Hang Lee, Gilles Ferrand, Daniel Patnaude, Shigehiro Nagataki, Rüdiger Pakmor, Samar Safi-Harb, Friedrich K. Röpke, Anne Decourchelle, Ivo R. Seitenzahl
arxiv-2601-20446.description: Abstract Type Ia supernovae (SNe), thermonuclear explosions of white dwarfs in binary systems, are widely used as standard candles owing to the empirical width-luminosity relation of their light curves. Recent theoretical and observational studies indicate a diversity of progenitor systems and explosion mechanisms.

pmc-10693315.creator: Jiangjun Cao, Zhe Zhang, Li Zhou, Maochao Luo, Lei Li, Bowen Li, Edouard C. Nice, Weifeng He, Shaojiang Zheng, Canhua Huang
pmc-10693315.description: Emerging evidence indicates that cancer cells can mimic characteristics of embryonic development, promoting their development and progression. Cancer cells share features with embryonic development, characterized by robust proliferation and differentiation regulated by signaling pathways such as Wnt, Notch, hedgehog, and Hippo signaling.

pmc-11395377.title: Retrospective cohort study of video-assisted thoracoscopic precise positioning reduction and internal fixation and thoracotomy reduction and internal fixation in treating multiple rib fractures
pmc-11395377.creator: Jinlong Shi, Jing Liu
pmc-11395377.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objective:This study aimed to assess the clinical effect of video-assisted thoracoscopic precise positioning reduction and internal fixation and thoracotomy reduction and internal fixation in the therapy of multiple rib fractures.Methods:A total of 80 patients with multiple rib fractures in First People’s Hospital of Jingzhou from January 2021 to December 2022 were separated into control group (CG, 40 cases) and research group (RG, 40 cases) by random number table method. Patients in the CG received thoracotomy reduction and internal fixation.

pmc-11698597.title: Effectiveness of pharmacist-managed oncology ambulatory care for patients with non-small cell lung cancer in Taiwan
pmc-11698597.creator: Ding-Cheng Liu, Chuan-Lun Hung, Yi-Wen Chen, Li-Na Kuo, Yen-Chun Hsin, Chun-Nan Kuo
pmc-11698597.description: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is commonly treated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). However, adverse events from such treatment can lead to treatment discontinuation and additional medical expenditures. Ambulatory care from oncology pharmacists in patient education and symptom management can benefit patients with NSCLC.

pmc-11715290.title: Retinal AD Biomarkers in Cognitively Unimpaired Older Adults
pmc-11715290.creator: Ashley N. Price, Peter J. Snyder, Jennifer Strenger, Louisa I. Thompson, Megan Stradtman, Stuart Sinoff, Jessica Alber
pmc-11715290.description: BackgroundThe retina is a novel biomarker target for examining AD pathology, specifically beta‐amyloid (Aβ). Though relationship between retinal Aβ and standard preclinical AD biomarkers (cerebral Aβ PET) remains understudied, retinal inclusion bodies (IB, strongly hypothesized to contain fibrillar Aβ), predict cerebral Aβ load in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC).

pmc-12533259.title: Programmable low-coherence wavefronts for enhanced localization
pmc-12533259.creator: Burak Bilgin, Jy-Chin Liao, Hou-Tong Chen, Chun-Chieh Chang, Sadhvikas Addamane, Michael P Lilly, Daniel M Mittleman, Edward W Knightly
pmc-12533259.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Engineering the properties of electromagnetic wavefronts has become essential to imaging, wireless security, sensing, and wireless communication. In particular, wavefronts that exhibit low spatial coherence can enable sensing functionalities with high accuracy and low latency. The typical use of such wavefronts cannot take advantage of these possibilities, as they require the ability to dynamically reconfigure the wavefront in a controllable and repeatable fashion, over a broad spectral bandwidth.

pmc-12559219.title: Evaluation of soil quality frameworks in rice-wheat systems under integrated nutrient management in Indo-Gangetic plains
pmc-12559219.creator: Tridiv Ghosh, Bappa Das, Debashis Chakraborty, Vinod Kumar Singh, Debarup Das, Pramila Aggarwal, Abhijit Sarkar, Prakash Kumar Jha, P. V. Vara Prasad
pmc-12559219.description: Sustaining soil quality under intensive land use systems to feed the growing population is a major challenge in the developing world. A prerequisite for effective soil quality analysis is the selection of a minimum data set (MDS) which effectively represents a given production system.

pmc-12628715.title: What training and support do people need to make optimal use of automated insulin delivery systems: Interview study
pmc-12628715.creator: Julia Lawton, Catriona J Kyle, Thomas J G Chambers, Lesley Steven, Ashton Currie, Fraser Gibb, John A McKnight, David Rankin

Indeed, most guidance has been driven by clinician opinion rather than users' experiences and needs.

pmc-12647033.title: The effects of Chinese botanical lotion and pimecrolimus cream in the treatment of chronic perianal eczema: a randomized clinical trial

pmc-12647033.description: BackgroundFumigation and sitz-bath therapy are traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) practices that offer unique benefits for managing chronic perianal eczema (CPE). This study aimed to investigate the clinical efficacy of the traditional Chinese herbal lotion (anal pruritus lotion, APL) combined with pimecrolimus cream in CPE treatment.MethodsPatients with CPE admitted between October 2019 and March 2022 were analyzed.

pmc-12711600.title: Complementary Strategies of Hydraulic Variability and Conservative Stomatal Regulation Enable Widespread Distributions in a Heterogeneous Karst Landscape
pmc-12711600.creator: Xiaojuan Wang, Xuefeng Ma, Rilian Ma, Bin Wang, Fengsen Tan, Qiwei Zhang
pmc-12711600.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Karst ecosystems display pronounced elevational heterogeneity driven by steep water and soil gradients, fostering niche differentiation as a biodiversity maintenance mechanism. While hydraulic trait divergence underpins such distribution patterns, certain species thrive across diverse microhabitats. Intraspecific variability in drought‐resistant hydraulic traits may enable such broad‐niche species to exploit habitat heterogeneity, but whether it is a key mechanism in karst ecosystems is unclear.

pmc-13068741.title: Stratifying the shoreline: a modified OSPAR framework to monitor event-driven beach litter
pmc-13068741.creator: Zara Teixeira, Ana Cunha, Paula C S Carvalho, Carlos Gonçalves, Cátia Marques, A Cristina Rocha, Ana Bóia, Diana Pacheco, Diana Marques, Luís Resende, João Fernandes, Cláudia Moreira
pmc-13068741.description: Urban beaches are increasingly vulnerable to litter accumulation, especially during large-scale coastal events that create short-lived but intense pollution pulses. Despite growing interest in marine litter monitoring, traditional methods often lack the spatial and temporal sensitivity required to capture such episodic surges.

pmc-13202398.title: Towards palliative care for all: Translation and cross-cultural adaptation of the Supportive and Palliative Care Indicators Tool-4ALL (SPICT-4ALL) to the Tamil healthcare context in India and Sri Lanka
pmc-13202398.creator: Shunmuga Priya I C, Shamini Prathapan, Jyothsna Kuriakose, Gobith Ratnasingam, Ruby Angeline Pricilla S, Sajitha MF Rahman, Daniel Munday, Kirsty Boyd, Scott A Murray, GVMC Fernando, Jenifer Jeba Sundararaj

Cross-cultural adaptation used a modified Delphi-technique.

pmc-13354538.title: Inflammatory-myofibroblastic tumour with acute calculous cholecystitis in a sessile gall bladder in a young woman
pmc-13354538.creator: Venkiteswaran Muralidhar, Ram Prasath, Govindasamy Prabhu, Jyothi Ravuri
pmc-13354538.description: A woman in her 30s presented with acute cholecystitis. Blood and radiological investigations supported the clinical diagnosis. Diagnostic laparoscopy showed a thickened inflamed gall bladder (GB). Laparotomy was performed that showed a thickened sessile inflamed GB. There was no involvement of adjacent organs, ascites or metastasis. Histopathology showed an inflammatory myofibroblastic tumour (IMT) in a sessile GB.

pmc-13682606.title: ClC-7 links PIKfyve inhibition to Rab-dependent LRRK2 activity at lysosomes
pmc-13682606.creator: Devin Clegg, Amanda Bentley-DeSousa, Agnes Roczniak-Ferguson, Shawn M. Ferguson
pmc-13682606.description: Clegg et al. show that LRRK2 integrates distinct lysosomal stress signals through stimulus-specific combinations of interactions with Rab GTPases and GABARAP. PIKfyve inhibition activates LRRK2 through ClC-7–dependent accumulation of a subset of Rabs on lysosomes without requiring GABARAP, whereas CASM-inducing stresses require both Rab and GABARAP interactions.
